title: Event modifiers
source: Both files are read by LoadModifierDefinitions (0x5A490) into CStaticModifier, whose keys are CModifier's: `icon` and the modifier names (see modifier_names). Loaded after common/ideologies.txt, so the suseptibility_<faction> names exist by then (FINDINGS-startup.md section 7). Names are looked up by add_country_modifier and the like.

file.desc: named modifiers an event, decision or history applies

patterns.desc: a modifier, by the name scripts apply it with

icon.desc: the frame of the modifier icon strip shown for it
